Run and jump against two rivals. Tiles collapse behind everyone; cut off their routes and save a landing for yourself.

A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

TNT Floor Frenzy

  1. Move and jump. Tiles flash after you step on them, then fall. Save a route for your next move.
  2. MOVE + JUMP. WASD + Space.
  3. Points, progress and the next target stay visible. END saves a result. Retry starts fresh.
Credits & sources

Unofficial fan game. Three.js and skinview3d: MIT. Character geometry and textures: Mojang Bedrock Samples, original Mojang/Microsoft rights retained. Full sources: assets/sources.json. Silkscreen: OFL. Original scene, game rules, acting, UI and synthesized sound.
